title: FreeMax Mesh Pro (Kanthal) Coils
description:
FreeMax Kanthal Replacement Coils:
These FreeMax Kanthal coils were the first multiple mesh coils in the world. This innovative design ensures these coils produce excellent flavor and vapor production.
These coils are designed to work with the following tanks:
– FreeMax Mesh Pro Tank
– FreeMax Fireluke Tank
– FreeMax Fireluke Pro Tank
– FreeMax Fireluke M Pro Tank
These coils are not compatible with the FreeMax Fireluke Mesh, M, 2 & 3 series tanks.
Coils with a resistance less than 1.0-ohm are known as sub-ohm coils. These coils require a lot of power and heat up very quickly. To make sure your e-liquid doesn’t vaporize too fast (leading to burned coils), we recommend using a thicker high-VG e-liquid like our 70/30 e-liquids (70% VG to 30% PG).
FreeMax Kanthal Single Mesh 0.15Ω Coil –
Recommended 40-70W
FreeMax Kanthal Double Mesh 0.2Ω Coil –
Recommended 60-90W
FreeMax Kanthal Triple Mesh 0.15Ω Coil –
Recommended 80-110W
